What did Jonny ask for Christmas?
en.selectedTitle: 🎄 Jonny's First Wish List! | Christmas Special #3 #Shorts
en.description: Little Jonny is writing his very first wish list for Santa! Come see what he asked for in this magical Funny Spitz Family journey.

text.pt: Bem-vindos ao terceiro dia do nosso especial! Hoje o pequeno Jonny preparou algo muito especial.
text.en: Welcome to the third day of our special! Today little Jonny has prepared something very special.

scenes.imagePrompt: Fotorrealistic Pixar 3D style, black Pomeranian dog Raven wearing round gold-rimmed glasses, pearl necklace, and floral dress. She is holding a golden paper in a cozy living room decorated with warm Christmas lights and garlands, 9:16 vertical.

text.pt: Jonny, querido, pegue este papel dourado para escrevermos sua primeira cartinha para o Papai Noel.
text.en: Jonny, dear, take this golden paper so we can write your first letter to Santa Claus.

scenes.imagePrompt: Fotorrealistic Pixar 3D style, cream-orange Pomeranian dog Theo wearing rainbow multicolored glasses and a blue button-down shirt. He is pointing at a toy catalog, surrounded by red and green Christmas ornaments, 9:16 vertical.

text.pt: Ei Jonny, não esqueça de pedir aquela pista de corrida gigante e muitos petiscos crocantes!
text.en: Hey Jonny, do not forget to ask for that giant race track and many crunchy treats!

scenes.imagePrompt: Fotorrealistic Pixar 3D style, cream-golden Pomeranian dog Jonny with NO glasses, wearing a white button-down shirt and a dark bow tie. He is sitting at a wooden table with a thoughtful expression, holding a quill, 9:16 vertical.

text.pt: Eu quero pedir coisas legais, mas o mais importante é estarmos todos juntos nesta noite.
text.en: I want to ask for cool things, but the most important is being all together tonight.

scenes.imagePrompt: Fotorrealistic Pixar 3D style, black Pomeranian dog Luna wearing round gold-rimmed glasses, pearl necklace, and a pink ruffled blouse. She is leaning over Jonny's shoulder in a warm, festive environment, 9:16 vertical.

text.pt: Que lindo, maninho! Escrever os desejos ajuda a espalhar a magia do Natal por toda casa.
text.en: How beautiful, little brother! Writing down wishes helps spread Christmas magic through the whole house.

scenes.imagePrompt: Fotorrealistic Pixar 3D style, cream-white Pomeranian dog Vlad wearing thin round gold-rimmed glasses, striped shirt, and navy bow tie. He is sitting in a large armchair next to a glowing Christmas tree, 9:16 vertical.

text.pt: Isso mesmo, campeão! O verdadeiro presente é o amor que compartilhamos enquanto montamos nossa árvore.
text.en: That is right, champ! The real gift is the love we share while setting our tree.

scenes.imagePrompt: Fotorrealistic Pixar 3D style, close up of cream-golden Pomeranian dog Jonny happily writing on the golden paper. Christmas lights are blurred in the background creating a bokeh effect, 9:16 vertical.

text.pt: Prontinho! Minha lista está cheia de sonhos e muito carinho para toda a nossa família.
text.en: All done! My list is full of dreams and lots of affection for our whole family.

scenes.imagePrompt: Fotorrealistic Pixar 3D style, Raven and Vlad standing together, smiling warmly at Jonny. They are in a festive hallway with mistletoe and golden decorations, 9:16 vertical.

text.pt: Estamos muito orgulhosos de você! Agora vamos colocar essa carta na nossa bota de Natal.
text.en: We are so proud of you! Now let us put this letter in our Christmas stocking.

text.pt: Desejamos que seus sonhos de Natal também comecem a se realizar hoje! Até amanhã, pessoal!
text.en: We wish that your Christmas dreams also start coming true today! See you tomorrow, everyone!

en: A new holiday story every day!
